name: api-tests
description: Operation-level API tests for Flight Club. Imports Wasp operations directly and calls them against a real test database — no browser, no Wasp server required.

scripts.db:reset: cd ../app && DATABASE_URL=$(grep 'DATABASE_URL' .wasp/out/server/.env | cut -d= -f2-) npx prisma migrate reset --force --schema=.wasp/out/db/schema.prisma
